about_the_game:
Please Note:

This is an early alpha version of what is planned to begin as an Arena-Shooter and then evolve into an Open World Sandbox with community-driven features.

Currently, it's a Single-Player test environment which I plan to continually update as more features are developed.

What is the Current State of this Project? :

In the current version of this project, you will find fully fleshed-out firearm mechanics for a pistol and rifle; leaning, crouching, sprinting, climbing; a basic equipment system, and a drivable vehicle, as well as smaller details such as physics based item interactions and rag-doll.

The world is crafted with high-definition graphics and global illumination with attention to detail for an immersive realistic experience.

What are the Goals of this Project? :

Initial mechanics & systems I plan to add:

1) Implementing Host-Based Multiplayer with Steam Lobbies

2) Adding more Firearms & Equipment 

3) Adding more Vehicles and improving Driving Mechanics & Audio

4) Creating Small-Medium Levels for competitive play

5) Adding custom Character & Item Models/Assets

Long-term Goals:

1) Expanding Open World w/ Dynamic Features (weather, day-night cycle, etc...)

2) Implementing an Inventory Management & Crafting System

3) Adding AI/ NPC Systems

3) Porting over to Dedicated Servers

You can provide direct feedback to me on X/Twitter: @BlankCanvasSB

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A

short_description: A small, single-player environment to test my new game currently under development. Shoot guns, drive a car, and admire the scenery!
